rules.description: Kubernetes, container, serverless, and cloud-specific attack detection
rules.query: SELECT "siem_cloud_native_cloud_native_067", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%container%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%escape%') AND "value" > 0
